name: Benigumo / Red Spider
source:
Yvet grew up as an orphan on the Mainland. She was taken in by a crime syndicate when she was young and trained as an assassin.

She killed many people, but she had her reasons for breaking out of that group. She escaped and married Francis, the leader of the Red Flower Society, an underworld mob that operated in Kowloon, Hong Kong.

One day, Francis was shot in a nightclub, and a doctor said that it was highly unlikely he would regain consciousness.

Yvet takes over his responsibilities and tries to find the person who was behind the shooting, with her bodyguards and a private detective, her acquaintance.

[From [url=http://www.rpgdl.org/rsl/en.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
伊薇特在大陆的孤儿院长大，年幼时被犯罪组织收留并训练成杀手。

她杀过许多人，却有自己的理由离开组织。逃出之后，她嫁给了弗朗西斯。弗朗西斯是“红花会”的首领，这个黑帮组织盘踞在香港九龙。

某天，弗朗西斯在一家夜总会遭枪击。医生表示，他醒来的可能性极低。

伊薇特接手他的事务，在保镖和一名熟识的私家侦探协助下，试图查明枪击案的幕后黑手。

[来源：[url=http://www.rpgdl.org/rsl/en.html]官方网站[/url]]
